sources.prompt:
Japanese anime-style chibi mobile-game environment art, like the tile set of a cosy slice-of-life anime puzzle game. Drawn by hand by a professional 2D anime game background artist: flat cel colours with one crisp hard-edged shadow tone, thick dark-brown outline (#4A2A1A) with slight natural line-weight variation (thicker on outer silhouettes, thinner on inner details), one small flat white highlight per shiny surface, chunky rounded chibi shapes (buildings, trees, rocks and props squashed and rounded like cute toys), limited warm Japanese palette, light from the top-left. Few, deliberate details, every shape clearly readable at 64 pixels. Avoid the typical AI-art look: no airbrushed or soft gradient shading, no plastic or 3D-render sheen, no photographic texture, no texture noise, no random extra sparkles or particles, no melted or merged details, no blurry edges. No characters or people unless asked, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Outline weight matches a cartoon salmon-nigiri game icon.

Setting: the Omakase Counter region of the map, the finest omakase sushi counter: black lacquer, gold leaf, pale hinoki wood, bonsai pines and gold folding screens. Region colours: banner #D4A537 to #9A6A12, land #D9C08A.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Straight top-down view, flat, no perspective. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Ground tiles fill their cell edge to edge, opaque, with no outline or border round the cell; the left edge matches the right edge and the top edge matches the bottom edge so each repeats seamlessly.

Land:
f1 (top-left) land_a: pale raked gravel with fine parallel lines in #D9C08A.
f2 (top-right) land_b: the same ground about 12% lighter, details in other places, so it alternates with land_a.
f3 (bottom-left) land_c: land_a with a single flat stepping stone.
f4 (bottom-right) land_d: land_b with a single flat stepping stone.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 opaque PNG with four exact equal logical quadrants, no drawn cell borders or gutters. Straight top-down 2D ground. Uniform pale golden raked-gravel base #D9C08A in left-column cells, about 12% lighter #E7D5A8 in right-column cells. Fine evenly spaced parallel horizontal rake lines in low-contrast tan, very restrained and readable at 64px, same regular spacing for seamless repetition. Borders must repeat cleanly, left/right and top/bottom. Lower cells each contain exactly ONE flat rounded grey-beige stepping stone with a crisp dark-brown outline and one small hard shadow tone; stone stays at least 15% from quadrant edges and has different placement in each lower cell. No specks, noisy grain, photo textures, gradients, vignette, edge shading, plants, buildings, mountains or scenic props.

Tile sheet: 2x2 grid of 4 equal 512x512 cells, one item per cell, no borders, no grid lines, no gutters, no labels, no numbers. Top-down three-quarter view, seen from above at about 45 degrees, each object sitting on an invisible ground with its base near the bottom of its cell. Every item at the same scale with the same outline weight. Standalone items are centred with about 10% empty margin. Everything outside the items is fully transparent.

Deco tiles:
f1 (top-left) mountain: a mountain painted in gold leaf like a folding screen (not on this band today).
f2 (top-right) forest: a neatly clipped bonsai pine on a stone (not on this band today).
f3 (bottom-left) city: an elegant black-lacquer restaurant with a gold-trimmed roof and a white noren curtain.
f4 (bottom-right) special: a hinoki counter with a chef knife on a cloth.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output square 1024x1024 transparent PNG atlas with four EXACT logical quadrants of equal size. Every COMPLETE prop fits inside the INNER 70% of its own quadrant with at least 15% clear margin on every side. Top-left: a freestanding small gold-leaf folding screen with a clearly readable mountain landscape painted on its panels, a Japanese byobu, gold and charcoal flat shapes. Top-right: one neatly clipped bonsai pine perched on a rounded stone. Bottom-left: one elegant compact black-lacquer restaurant building with a gold-trimmed roof and a plain white noren curtain with NO writing. Bottom-right: a short pale hinoki sushi counter with ONE chef knife lying on a folded white cloth. View from above at about 45 degrees. Chunky rounded toy-like proportions, crisp dark-brown outlines #4A2A1A, flat cel colors and one hard shadow tone. No photo texture, gradients, cast shadow haze, characters, letters, labels, logos or other objects. Actual alpha transparency outside each prop and in openings, no common background or ground. Complete silhouettes, clear gap between all four props and central boundaries.

edits.prompt: Edit this transparent Omakase 2x2 game-prop atlas. Preserve all four designs, colors and quadrant assignments: gold mountain folding screen top-left, bonsai pine on stone top-right, black-and-gold restaurant with white noren bottom-left, hinoki counter with knife on white cloth bottom-right. Fix only layout and spacing: SHRINK EACH COMPLETE prop to 75% of current size and recenter it in its own EXACT equal quadrant. Each complete silhouette needs at least 15% transparent margin from all four quadrant edges. Restore the whole restaurant roof outline, with no part crossing the vertical central boundary. No clipped outlines, no prop touching canvas edges or center boundaries, clear transparent gap between every object. No new props, lettering or labels. Keep crisp dark-brown outlines, flat cel shadow shapes and actual fully transparent alpha background. Square 1024x1024 PNG.
